verdict.rationale: Gusto's own announcement says entrepreneurs can register for a federal EIN within a single guided formation flow (gusto-docs-25, gusto-docs-26). However, the capability is explicitly in early beta and only rolling out to more entrepreneurs over the coming months (gusto-docs-27). The wording "guides business owners through registering" leaves it unclear whether Gusto obtains the EIN for the founder or only assists them. Missing for 10: general availability beyond early beta, detailed docs on how the EIN is actually obtained (filed by Gusto vs. user-guided), independent or hands-on corroboration of EIN issuance.
